dishes.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake before serving

steps.text: Push an almond into each prune.
Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.
Serve warm.
Blend the juice, ice and vodka until slushy.
Pour into shot glasses and serve straight away. Leave out the vodka for anyone not drinking.

dishes.make_ahead: Salt the roast the day before

steps.text: Salt the roast the day before and leave it uncovered in the fridge.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef.
Roast the potatoes in oil at 200C while the beef rests.
Blast the beef at 260C for a crust.
Simmer the pan juices with the stock for jus.
Carve and serve with horseradish cream, potatoes and jus.
Beat the butter, most of the sugar and the orange zest until pale.
Add the eggs, then fold in the flour with the orange juice.
Bake in a lined tin at 170C.
Boil the concentrate with the remaining sugar and brush over the warm cake.
Squeeze the oranges and chill the juice well.
Fill four flutes halfway with juice and gently top with sparkling wine, pouring slowly.

ingredients.item: diced veal or turtle-style beef shin

steps.text: Brown the meat in butter, then soften the onion and celery.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and pepper.
Simmer gently until the meat is tender and the soup is dark.
Serve with the chopped egg and sherry poured at the table.

ingredients.item: jumbo prawns, peeled with tails on

steps.text: Poach the prawns with the lemon, then chill in iced water.
Mix the tomato sauce and horseradish for a sharp red sauce.
Serve on cracked ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.
Coddle the egg in simmering water.
Crush the garlic and anchovies, whisk with the egg, lemon juice and oil.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing at the table.
Top with croutons and parmesan.

dishes.make_ahead: Salt the roast the day before

steps.text: Salt the roast the day before and leave it uncovered in the fridge.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef.
Blast at 260C for a crust.
Simmer the pan juices with the stock for jus.
Carve to order.

dishes.make_ahead: Cakes shaped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Gently mix the crab, mayonnaise, egg, Dijon and crumbs, barely binding.
Shape 8 cakes and chill.
Brown in butter, turning once.
Serve with tartare and lemon.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then toss with butter and parsley.
Dust the sole with flour.
Brown in butter, turning once.
Bone at the table and serve with lemon.
Mix the rice, milk, sugar and vanilla in a baking dish.
Bake at 150C, stirring now and then, until creamy.
Finish with nutmeg.
Blend the vodka, juice and ice until thick and slushy.
Pour into chilled glasses.

s.note: Almond-stuffed prunes wrapped in crisp streaky bacon.
s.how: Push an almond into each of 20 pitted prunes. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon, using 10 rashers, and secure with a toothpick. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Serve warm.

s.note: Icy orange juice slush with a splash of vodka.
s.how: Blend 500ml orange juice with 2 cups ice and 80ml vodka until slushy. Pour into shot glasses and serve straight away, before the market closes. Leave out the vodka for anyone not drinking.

m.note: Slow-roasted rib roast with jus, horseradish cream and potatoes.
m.how: Salt a 2kg standing rib roast the day before and leave uncovered in the fridge. Roast at 120C until 52C inside, about 2.5 hours, rest 30 minutes, then blast at 260C for 8 minutes for a crust. Simmer the pan juices with 300ml beef stock for jus. Serve with 150g horseradish cream and 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: Orange butter cake soaked in a sticky orange glaze.
w.how: Beat 200g butter, 200g caster sugar and the zest of 2 oranges, add 3 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour with 100ml orange juice. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Boil 100ml orange juice concentrate with 50g sugar for 3 minutes and brush over the warm cake.

d.note: Fresh orange juice and chilled sparkling wine in flutes.
d.how: Squeeze 4 oranges, about 300ml juice, and chill well. Fill four flutes halfway with the juice and gently top with chilled sparkling wine, about 300ml in total, pouring slowly so it does not foam over.
